summary: apps/ye-olde-magic-shop/src/styles.css imports Cinzel and Inter from fonts.googleapis.com on every route, so the app reaches an external origin on every page load and tests/reagent-map-globe.spec.ts has to name and skip two hosts in its no-request check. This chore self-hosts both fonts via @fontsource/cinzel and @fontsource/inter pinned to exact versions, removes the cross-origin @import and the matching test exception, adds a new document.fonts.load-based test proving the fonts actually render, and removes the now-resolved Google Fonts gap from docs/testing-cesium.md. A verified salvage commit (3629f44, branch salvage/local-fonts) already contains this work; the job is to re-apply it, hand-port the docs/testing-cesium.md hunk (that file changed on main since the salvage commit), and verify every acceptance criterion rather than rewrite the solution.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Cinzel (400, 700) and Inter (400, 600) MUST load from the app's own origin, through @fontsource/cinzel and @fontsource/inter pinned to exact versions, and src/styles.css MUST have no @import from another origin.
examples: src/styles.css's only @import is the local "tailwindcss" import

acceptanceCriteria.statement: tests/reagent-map-globe.spec.ts MUST drop PRE_EXISTING_OFF_ORIGIN_HOSTS and the code that skips those hosts, and its no-request test MUST pass with no exception.
The no-request test MUST fail when the old cross-origin @import is restored. Record the failing output in the delivery record.
examples: Temporarily re-add the Google Fonts @import line to styles.css, re-run the no-request test, capture the failure, then revert

acceptanceCriteria.statement: A page opened in the runner image MUST still render headings in Cinzel and body text in Inter, checked in tests/local-fonts.spec.ts with document.fonts.load at the exact weight, never document.fonts.check.
examples: document.fonts.check returned true even with the font imports removed in the salvage run — this is why the AC forbids it
Record the test failing with all four @fontsource imports removed
Record the test failing with only the Inter 600 import removed

acceptanceCriteria.statement: docs/testing-cesium.md's Google Fonts entry under "Known gaps" MUST be gone, and the file MUST still follow .claude/rules/writing-style.md.
scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh and scripts/ui-suite-in-chrome.sh --ubi9 MUST both pass.

Every new or changed function MUST have cyclomatic complexity below 7, every changed line MUST be covered by a test that can fail, and no file outside scope.paths MUST change (the run's own delivery record under docs/features/local-fonts/ excepted).
